note: Humphreys County (MS) publishes a parcel viewer (humphreyms ArcGIS Online org; Humphreys_Service FeatureServer with Parcels, districts, city limits) but no zoning district layer; the Parcels layer has no zoning field. Searches of the county, the state GIS portal (opendata.gis.ms.gov, gis.ms.gov, MARIS) and the ArcGIS catalog found no zoning polygons for the county or for Belzoni or Isola. Zoning in Belzoni and Isola is municipal; the county's website and the city site (belzonims.com) publish no zoning map or GIS service. Only third-party Zoneomics pages exist, which are not official.
